pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0143 model resource controls
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR0143 on current ADR0152 main. Local Ollama-compatible ModelBackends expose truthful provider-owned residency telemetry and verified unload/reload/CPU-offload operations. AI Studio releases supported local model residency before Editor restoration and managed Play, reacquires local residency only after authoritative-state re-inspection, and preserves ADR0152 work-claim ownership plus the existing AgentHost/native-runtime Resume path. ADR0144 Hosted API and Enterprise backends retain unavailable local GPU residency controls and existing Network/credential ownership. Provider-reported model telemetry is displayed without fabricating device-wide free VRAM or TTFT.

Deterministic adapter and orchestration tests cover truthful capability availability, verified unload/offload/reload transitions, Interrupt-for-Editing release before explicit Editor restoration, managed Play RuntimeRendering priority and reclaim, post-inspection Resume reload, and authoring-state-free resource planning. ADR0143 is Accepted.

## Validation

Windows Validation: affected. Visual Validation: required for AI Studio. Current visual validation auto-detects the AI Studio source diff; no AuthoringTool marker is used because AI Studio is not an AuthoringTool::ALL label.
